name: Aiman Abdullah
bio: Aiman's fascination with engines began as a child, tinkering with his grandfather's old scooter. He pursued mechanical engineering at university, specializing in precision manufacturing. After graduating, he honed his skills at a local automotive workshop before joining CRG Racing Team. Aiman believes in meticulous preparation and continuous improvement, always seeking marginal gains through innovative machining techniques. His ability to diagnose and rectify complex mechanical issues quickly has earned him the respect of his colleagues and made him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Aiman is of average height with a wiry build.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an exact point.
Hums quietly while working on complex machinery.
Keeps a small notebook filled with machining ideas and diagrams.
